label: Open a temporary window with Command+Option+N or File → New Little Zen. Use Open in Space to keep a page.
Open links from other apps in Little Zen
External routing applies to web links opened in Zen. The window inherits the current Space's container. Space routing applies when you keep the page in a Space.
Closing a temporary window discards its open tabs, as with Zen's blank windows. Normal browsing history still applies. Private windows remain private.
